profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Java Software Developer, primarily in back-end with strong background in project management and customer relationships. Experience in all stages of the development cycle on a variety of projects including user interaction, business modeling, estimations, analysis, design/architecture, documentation, coding, testing, deployment, infrastructure configurations, monitoring and support.  Analytical, self-taught, responsible, proactive and passionate about learning new technologies and new ways for solving problems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Business process design, development and automation.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Camunda BPM · Flowable · Java 8

positions.title: Software Developer Backend
positions.description: - Backend development in Java with Rest Services, Spring, MyBatis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, GitHub, dual Authentication through certificates and messaging with ActiveMQ and Apache Camel for the electronic pay system and reporting with TIBCO Jasper.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring MVC · Scrum · Git · MyBatis · ActiveMQ · PostgreSQL · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Spring Boot · Unit Testing · Relational Databases · Jasper Reports · Java · Spring Framework · Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) · Representational State Transfer (REST) · MongoDB · Apache Camel · REST APIs · GitHub · Jenkins · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · SQL · Back-End Web Development · Core Java
